title: Poincaré-Hopf Theorem for Isolated Determinantal Singularities
summary: Let $X$ be a projective algebraic $d$-variety endowed with isolated determinantal singularities, and let $ω$ be a $1$-form on $X$ exhibiting a finite number of singularities (in the stratified sense). Under some technical conditions, we use two generalizations of Poincaré-Hopf index with the goal of proving a Poincaré-Hopf Type Theorem for $X$.
